title: Event Hosts Guide to Using POAP NFTs for Event Engagement
summary: Learn how to leverage POAP NFTs to improve event engagement with DropChain's easy-to-use solution.
author: Nathaniel Thoreson
body:
Imagine attending a concert. The atmosphere is electric, the music resonates with your soul. Amidst this, you notice a QR code on your ticket. Curious, you scan it. After just three clicks, and in under 30 seconds, you are redirected to your newly created wallet with your unique NFT safely secured there. Suddenly, this isn't just any concert. You've just embarked on an exclusive journey, one that extends far beyond tonight's tunes.

Three months later, an email arrives. As a POAP holder, you're invited to an exclusive VIP event - an intimate acoustic session with the artist. This is the power of a Proof Of Attendance Protocol (POAP) - transforming a moment into a lasting, engaging experience.

Ready to make your own POAP experiences? Join the waitlist.


What Exactly is a POAP?

A POAP is a blockchain-based NFT (Non-Fungible Token) that represents proof of attendance and is forever on the blockchain. It's unique, tamper-proof, and as personal as the experience itself. Think of it as a digital collectible that offers more than just memories; it's a key to future experiences and benefits.

‍

The Value for Event Organizers

Why should event hosts dive into the world of POAPs? The answer lies in engagement and future interaction. POAPs aren't just souvenirs; they're engagement tools. 

By issuing a POAP, you're thanking attendees for coming and inviting them to be part of an ongoing community. This continuous engagement paves the way for increased attendance and loyalty, offering a gateway to interact with NFT holders in the future.
